{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h=rng.randint(6,14); w=rng.randint(6,14)
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    colors=[9,2,3]
    used=set()
    # create three diagonal endpoint pairs, mostly either slope +1 or -1
    for c in colors:
        for _ in range(100):
            dr=rng.choice([-1,1]); dc=rng.choice([-1,1])
            length=rng.randint(2,min(h,w)//2+1)
            r=rng.randint(0,h-1-abs(dr)*(length-1))
            cc=rng.randint(0,w-1-abs(dc)*(length-1))
            r2=r+dr*(length-1); c2=cc+dc*(length-1)
            if all((r+dr*i,cc+dc*i) not in used for i in range(length)):
                g[r][cc]=c; g[r2][c2]=c
                used.add((r,cc)); used.add((r2,c2)); break
    return g"}
